description: The ads a domain is running right now on Facebook/Instagram (Meta Ad Library) and Google (Ads Transparency Center): headline, body copy, CTA, landing page URL, creative/video URL, platforms and start dates. Use when the user asks what a competitor is advertising, whether they run paid ads, how long an ad has been live, or wants hooks and angles to model. Costs credits; the same domain re-queried within a week is free. Each source reports separately — null means that source could not be checked, an empty list means it was checked and found nothing.
